reader.requirement: At --std 85 the MERGE statement's file-name-1 must name a file described by an SD entry; a file described by an FD, a name that is no file, and a data-name must be refused.
reader.edition-search: BindMerge's file-name-1 arm is ResolveFile then `if (!file.IsSortMerge)` with no edition test; grep of SortBinder.cs for Edition.Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehaviors|Year finds only lines 517 (RELEASE) and 927 (ScreenSameClauses).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c18-merge-file-not-sort-merge covers the FD case; the undefined name and data-name cases are exercised only by this slice's probes

at 85: COBOL1757 MERGE file 'F3' is not described in a sort-merge description entry
